plain_english_policy: Enactment of this bill would establish a new judicial position (Judgeship Number 3) within Alabama's Twenty-seventh Judicial Circuit in Marshall County. The policy direction is to expand the local court system by creating an additional circuit judge who will be elected by voters at the general election held in January 2012, serving a six-year term starting shortly thereafter. To support this expansion, the state would appropriate funds from the State General Fund to cover the salary and necessary expenses for the new judgeship.
policy_direction_if_enacted: The bill creates an additional circuit judgeship (numbered 3) in Marshall County's Twenty-seventh Judicial Circuit. The position is filled by election at the general election in January 2012, with a six-year term beginning shortly after that date. The new judge will have full jurisdiction and authority equivalent to other circuit judges but cannot receive salary supplements or expense allowances under existing law (Chapter 10A, Title 12). Funding for this position is appropriated from the State General Fund as determined by the Director of Finance.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative McLaughlin sponsored the bill to advance the creation of a new judgeship in Marshall County.
evidence_quotes: "This bill would create an additional circuit judgeship... in the Twenty-seventh Judicial Circuit, comprised of Marshall County."
"The initial circuit judgeship would be filled by election at the general election in 2012."
"There is hereby appropriated from the State General Fund such additional funds as may be required... to fully fund the additional judgeship"
